content: We use the row-level attention $\beta _{t, i}$ as guidance for choosing row based on row's general representation. Then we use it to re-weight the record-level attention $\gamma _{t, i, j}$ and change the attention weight in base model to $\tilde{\alpha }_{t, i, j}$. Please note that ${\tilde{\alpha }_{t, i, j}}$ sum to 1 across all records in all tables.
